verdict.rationale: Yapily documents a sandbox with test bank accounts for simulating open banking connections (docs-12) and credential-based auth using an Application ID and Secret (docs-23). For client libraries, it offers code generation from its OpenAPI v3 spec for Java, Python, Node.js and more (docs-8, docs-22), rather than shipping maintained first-party SDKs. The probe found no OpenAPI file at the common paths on the docs domain, which adds a little friction but does not contradict the spec's existence. missing for 10: evidence that API keys are self-serve at signup, a runnable step-by-step quickstart to a first linked sandbox account, first-party maintained SDKs, and hands-on corroboration of time-to-first-call.
